milestone: Ref[2]-based 2D Improved U-Net implementation and shared-pipeline integration

reference.course: COMP3710_Report_2026_v2.5.pdf, p6 2D Improved U-Net [2]; p20 reference [2]
reference.paper: Isensee et al. (2018), Brain Tumor Segmentation and Radiomics Survival Prediction: Contribution to the BRATS 2017 Challenge

architecture.context: five scales, preactivation residual two-convolution blocks
architecture.localization: skip concatenation then 3x3 preserving concatenated channels, followed by 1x1 halving channels
architecture.heads: quarter, half, full logits; progressive nearest upsample and elementwise sum
architecture.output: single raw-logit tensor, no auxiliary losses

adaptation_choices: all spatial operations adapted from 3D to 2D
channel-wise dropout, affine instance normalization and exactly three heads are explicit implementation choices
base width 16 is a shared resource choice, not the full paper configuration
shared cross-entropy and baseline smoke optimizer/settings retained; paper Dice-loss training recipe is not reproduced

runs_in_order.purpose: regression against prior milestone, not an additional tuned baseline

shared_protocol.selection: same fixed seeded subset including case_004_week_0_slice_12 as prior baseline

claim_boundary: This milestone demonstrates implementation and integration. A 64-sample two-epoch smoke is not a formal architecture comparison, ablation or final quality result. Same seed does not imply identical initial weights across architectures.
pre_run_revision_note: Before either real run, localization reviewed against reference section 2.1: 3x3 preserves concatenated channels and 1x1 halves them; checks rerun.
